description: This file defines a template class PointerSet for managing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers, including internal node structure, set operations, and iterators.

classes.name: PointerSetNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the PointerSet, storing a pointer and providing methods for null, tombstone, validity checks, and hashing.

classes.name: PointerSet<T>
classes.description: A template class implementing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers with fast lookup, insertion, removal, and iteration capabilities.

methods.name: PointerSet(const PointerSet& other)
methods.description: Copy constructor, initializes set by inserting elements from another set.

methods.name: PointerSet(InputIter first, InputIter last)
methods.description: Range constructor, inserts elements from iterator range.

methods.name: add(T* ptr)
methods.description: Adds a pointer to the set; returns true if added, false if already present.

methods.name: contains(T* ptr) const
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is in the set.

methods.name: erase(T* ptr)
methods.description: Removes a pointer from the set; returns true if removed.

methods.name: insert(T* ptr)
methods.description: Inserts a pointer into the set, same as add.

methods.name: insert(const PointerSet& other)
methods.description: Inserts all elements from another PointerSet.

methods.name: intersection_with(const PointerSet& other) const
methods.description: Returns a new PointerSet that is the intersection with another set.

methods.name: ToVector() const
methods.description: Converts the set to a vector of pointers.

methods.name: Lookup(T* ptr) const
methods.description: Internal method to find the node matching a pointer.
